description: Preview a contained MOGRT import into one explicitly named disposable Premiere verification sequence and empty video track. It does not contact Premiere or alter a sequence.

audio_track_index.description: Audio track index passed to Premiere; defaults to 0.

sequence_id.description: Exact Premiere sequence identifier to recheck before import.

start_seconds.description: Insertion start time in seconds; defaults to 0.

video_track_index.description: Empty video track index for the imported MOGRT; defaults to 0.

name: preview_mogrt_premiere_handoff

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Preview Mogrt Premiere Handoff
